author: assistant (claude-opus-5), M2 P2.22
edge_cases: A run of exactly two identical characters is kept in full. A run of length k above two is reduced to two characters.
input_semantics: One parameter, s, a string of lowercase English letters.
load_bearing: Only consecutive repetition matters; the same character may appear many times in the result provided no three sit adjacent. Characters are removed, and the order of those that remain is preserved.
required_operation: Remove the fewest characters from a string so that no character appears three or more times consecutively, and report the resulting string.
source_basis: The question title and the boilerplate method name, both from this project's own bank. The bank stores NO problem description — its content field holds a placeholder and a generic example — so the behaviour described here comes from the assistant's own knowledge of the canonical task. No sentence is copied from any external problem statement.
title: Delete Characters to Make Fancy String
